summary: Brown tweeted that events in Israel, Gaza, and West Bank are 'heartbreaking' and called for de-escalation, framing the conflict symmetrically without naming a party responsible.

summary: Brown's spokesperson affirmed his commitment to funding Israel's war, citing Israel's 'right to defend itself,' and noted he voted to send critical military support to Israel.
quote: The spokesperson affirmed Brown's commitment to funding Israel's war on Gaza, citing Israel's 'right to defend itself.' The spokesperson said Brown voted last week 'to send critical military support to Israel, along with humanitarian aid to Gaza.'

summary: Brown voted for the April 2024 supplemental funding military aid to Israel and in November 2024 voted against all three resolutions (S.J.Res. 111, 113, 115) that would have blocked arms transfers.
quote: he voted for the April 2024 supplemental that funded military aid to the government of Israel alongside humanitarian aid for Gaza, and in November 2024 voted against all three resolutions that would have blocked specific arms transfers (S.J.Res. 111, S.J.Res. 113, S.J.Res. 115)

summary: On October 10, 2023, Brown stated Israel had the right to exist and defend itself, pledging to work with colleagues and the administration to support Israel and defeat Hamas.
